Room in Midtown East apartment starting on May 1!

OVERVIEW
* Three 26-27 year old guys re-signing our lease and looking to fill a room starting on May 1. We work in consulting/tech, like sports, being active, and hosting at the apartment
* The lease will run May 1 2026 - April 30 2027
* The room is $2175/month, roughly 12x10 (can fit a queen size bed, dresser, desk, etc.) and has a large attached balcony 

ABOUT THE APARTMENT
* 47th St & 2nd Ave
* 4 beds, 2.5 bathrooms (2 full baths / 1 half bath)
* Washer/dryer in-unit
* Dishwasher in-unit
* Two huge outdoor balconies (~18x5 and ~12x5) that are great for hosting
* Large storage closet in living room
* Apartment is furnished except for bedroom

ABOUT THE BUILDING
* 24/7 doorman/concierge service 
* Building gym + lounge
* 10-minute walk to Grand Central connected to all subway lines
* 15-min walk to Trader Joe's, Whole Foods
* 3-min walk to Morton Williams
* Close to multiple bars/restaurants
* 1 block away from 2 Citibike stops

Were trying to sign asap so reach out with any questions!!

Room Available for Rent in PLG, flexible move in April 1-May 1
Hi! I am looking for someone to take my room with a move in date between April 1 - May 1. Lease is up August 31st but option to re-sign! The apartment is spacious and furnished with two bedrooms, one bath, and in-unit laundry

You’d be living with an amazing, clean, and considerate roommate. The rent is $1,600/month. The 2 and 5 trains are literally around the corner and the neighborhood is full of cute coffee shops, multiple grocery stores, and everything you need within walking distance. I love this neighborhood and everyone in the building is very kind and respectful. Message me if you’re interested!
